## Export Hot Ones Sauces data as SPSS .sav file {.unnumbered}


### Description

Export Hot Ones Sauces data as SPSS .sav file



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>export_hotones_sauces_sav(
  path = "hotones_sauces_data.sav",
  use_sentinel = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="path">path</code></td>
<td>
File path. Defaults to &quot;superman_data.sav&quot;.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="use_sentinel">use_sentinel</code></td>
<td>
If TRUE (default), NA becomes -99 with SPSS missing codes.
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

Invisibly returns the labelled data frame.
